lines: Warna kya baat thi, kis baat ne rone na diya?
couplets.en: What else could have kept me from weeping?
In love, my heart held its pride.

lines: Aap kehte the ke rone se na badlenge naseeb
couplets.en: You used to say that tears would never change my fate.

lines: Umr bhar aap ki is baat ne rone na diya
couplets.en: Those words kept me from weeping all my life.
In love, my heart held its pride.

lines: Rone walon se kaho, unka bhi rona ro lein
couplets.en: Tell those who weep to shed a tear for them as well.

lines: Jinko majboori-e-haalaat ne rone na diya
couplets.en: Life had left them no room to weep.
In love, my heart held its pride.

lines: Tujh se mil kar hamein rona tha, bahut rona tha
couplets.en: When I saw you, I wanted to weep for a long while.
Our brief time together left no room for tears.
In love, my heart held its pride.

lines: Ek do roz ka sadma ho to ro lein, Faakir
couplets.en: If grief lasted a day or two, Faakir, I could weep.

lines: Hum ko har roz ke sadmaat ne rone na diya
couplets.en: The sorrows of each day left me no time to weep.

lines: Ishq mein ghairat-e-jazbaat ne rone na diya
couplets.en: In love, a quiet pride kept me from weeping.
